github.description: Hosted GitHub MCP. Authenticated automatically via your VS Code GitHub / Copilot sign-in — no PAT required. Reads code scanning, Dependabot, secret scanning, branch protection; opens issues and PRs.

microsoft-learn.description: Hosted Microsoft Learn MCP. No auth. Authoritative Microsoft security guidance, runbooks, Zero Trust patterns, Azure Policy + Defender docs.

deepwiki.description: Hosted DeepWiki MCP (Cognition). No auth. Repo-level knowledge base over public GitHub repos — use to pull CodeQL / Semgrep / Trivy / Snyk rules documentation and the GitHub Advisory DB by asking about their repos.

context7.description: Hosted Context7 MCP (Upstash). No auth for public libraries. Up-to-date library / framework documentation — lets the agent look up the correct secure-API for React, Express, jsonwebtoken, lodash, axios, etc.

owasp-cheatsheets.description: Hosted gitmcp.io proxy over the OWASP Cheat Sheet Series repo. No auth. Security knowledge base covering XSS, SQLi, JWT, CORS, authN/Z, secrets management, input validation, supply chain — the orchestrator cites these cheat sheets when proposing remediations.

github-advisories.description: Hosted gitmcp.io proxy over the GitHub Advisory Database. No auth. Deterministic CVE / GHSA lookup — the orchestrator queries this to attach real advisory IDs and fixed-version ranges to Dependabot findings instead of inventing them.

playwright.description: Microsoft Playwright MCP. Runs locally via npx. Drives a real browser so the red-team agent can perform authenticated intrusion tests (XSS payloads, IDOR probes, prototype-pollution URLs, auth bypass) against the running demo app at http://localhost:5173. --isolated keeps state ephemeral; --headless avoids flashing a window on stage.
